comment: All candidates shared the architecture, so optimizer progress dominated. Estimated displacement ordered D (1.024), A (0.3072), C (0.03072), E (0.0192), B (0.0064), matching gold. K1001 and K1002 supported the large adaptive-versus-Adagrad progress differences and E over B. K1005 supported treating decay differences as secondary here. C versus E was less certain because their cross-optimizer displacement estimates were close (K1012). K1072's high-displacement risk is scoped to univariate regression, so it did not justify demoting D on this multivariate task. This result adds no tested general rule.
